method: sweep.py scenarios --family tnt_blast_<material> (tools/bds-sweep/tnt.py): a 9 x 9 x 9 cube of the material filled from (-4,-3,-4) to (4,5,4) around a TNT block at (0,1,0) (the superflat floor is y=-1, bedrock y=-4), primed by a redstone block set at (1,1,0); 110 ticks later every cube position is read and the item actors in the cell counted. `destroyed` lists the cube offsets that were air afterwards (the TNT and redstone block positions included); `dropped` sums the items by identifier.
row: [material, sample, witness, destroyed offsets, dropped items {item: count}]
